https://mastodon.social/@CrabbyIT@infose.name: Mr. Crab - Sysadmin from Heck
https://mastodon.social/@CrabbyIT@infose.text: I'm going through my bins of old video games and found hand written notes from someone I loved who passed written on old GameFAQs printouts. It brought up a lot of feelings. and most importantly it inspired me to build a retro gaming PC over the winter. Good thing I didn't purge ALL of my old hardware. Now if you'll excuse me, I'm going to make a cuppa tea and gaze longingly out the window while I remember better days. #nostalgia #retrogaming #windowsxp
